name: standing-hip-flexion-with-bands
instructions:
1. Setup in a standing position with a band looped around one foot and your arms by your sides.
2. Exhale and drive the knee up while keeping the spine neutral.
3. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
